notes.title: March 17, 2025 Update
notes.content:
This update includes the ability to hard drop the blocks with either the space bar or H key. This was requested by Steam reviewer "NidoAllFather" who suggested it. User "Kalycho" echoed the same thing. Also, a simple help screen has been added to the title screen. Press H for help and it will tell you about the controls. The hard drop feature should make the game play feel faster and more satisfying for those players who felt that it was too slow.

I would also like to respond to the review by user "Obey the Fist!". The truth is that the bad graphics is both because of my lack of skill and also the game was designed to look like it was made in the 1980s because that was the time period when Tetris was both created and published to the world. I also designed it to be extremely light and fast even on less powerful computers. Theoretically, it could probably run on a computer of the 80s or 90s if it was running Linux and supported SDL version 2.

I am not trying to compete with the Tetris company by making a 3D graphic equivalent. I don't want to go to jail but I am willing to for the sake of keeping the game alive and not let it be taken away from those who want to play it. When previous official Tetris games we delisted and fan made games were shut down, I grew to hate the Tetris company and worked for over a year at making Chaste Tris. It is my first game and contains all the passion I had for Tetris combined with all the computer programming experience I have, which is admittedly not very impressive I know. But I am proud of this achievement anyway.

notes.title: Chaste Tris 3
notes.content: Hello everyone! I am publishing the long overdue update to my game. This is built with SDL instead of the original Raylib. This should make things work smoother for all Steam users! When I made my game originally my best knowledge was with Raylib but over time I have come to see that SDL really is the best media library I have found. I hope that you will find this one pleasing because it has all the music of the original, but it also launches faster and should consume less memory than the previous version!

notes.title: SDL Rewrite
notes.content: I hope I did this right. I am publishing the long overdue update to my game. This is build with SDL instead of the original Raylib. This should make things work smoother for all Steam users!

notes.title: Fullscreen update
notes.content: This update contains fullscreen window support. This will hopefully make the game look a lot cooler!

notes.title: The title is now displayed in rainbow text!
notes.content: I also added hours to the time display instead of only minutes and seconds.

notes.title: New T Block Mode
notes.content: Entering -tgirl as a command line argument results in only T blocks being given. It's just like -longboi is for I blocks

notes.title: movelog corrections
notes.content:
If you've played this game. You'll know that accurate movelogs and replays are what make it special. I fixed some errors about the fact that the movelog couldn't rewind because it wrote to a file and there was no way to truncate it if you loaded to a previous state.

Therefore, it now only saves the movelog after the game loop ends. It keeps it entirely in memory during the game. This makes sure it is always the correct size and is perfectly compatible with the Lua version recently released on itch.io.

notes.title: Added a song
notes.content:
This update includes some music credits and adjustments to meet the terms of use for OC Remix because all 3 songs in the game are from there and I can legally use them as long as I give the artists credit. The license file is included if you view the files which are installed.

Also, I made the tracks cycle automatically rather than stopping all music after the end of a song.

notes.title: This update adds music and more savestates!
notes.content: Also added is a spinning 5 pointed star animation in the corner while playing just to be fancy!

notes.title: November 2 2022 Update
notes.content:
I added T Spin Triple support to Chaste Tris. Only T blocks are allowed to do this stupid rotation to match SRS rotation rules. However, all other blocks remain the same.

This was meant to test the Infinite TST loop invented by Massi4h. You can read more about that loop here:

https://harddrop.com/wiki/Infinite_TST

notes.title: Center Playing Field Update
notes.content:
For a few important reasons, I have changed the Tetris field to be in the center of the window. First, this is the way it has been done in literally every other Tetris game I have played. Second, I noticed that most preview videos on TikTok show the center of the video and not the sides. This makes all my own gameplay videos of Chaste Tris hard to tell apart. So I am correcting my previous error.

Also, I added a scrolling checkerboard animation to the right of the field because it is my favorite pattern!
